name: Perceval
description: Perceval is an open-source Python framework for programming photonic quantum computers, developed by Quandela. It provides tools for composing circuits from linear optical components, defining single-photon sources, manipulating Fock states, and running simulations on classical backends or Quandela cloud QPUs.

news.title: Perceval 1.2.4 released with Kipu Quantum Hub connector
news.excerpt: Perceval 1.2.4 adds a new KipuSession connector enabling job submission to the Kipu Quantum Hub (installable via pip install perceval-quandela[kipu]), and enhances GenericInterferometer to accept string values for interferometer shape specification.
